text:
tara: quick note from pairing today 1: our Node sample that posts jobs to SQS is losing request/tracing headers. worker logs show a different X-Req-Id than the incoming HTTP request.

mike: thanks for flagging. stack? express + aws-sdk SQS sendMessage / receiveMessage?

tara: yup. express -> sendMessage({ MessageBody }) -> lambda-like worker consumes. we assumed otel context or headers would carry over but ofc SQS is out-of-process.

sophie: typical pattern is to serialize `traceparent` and `x-request-id` into message attributes. small helper in SDK would reduce churn. e.g. `sdk.enqueueSqs(queueUrl, body, {context})` which sets MessageAttributes.Traceparent and RequestId.

leo: agreed. also for onboarding, our sample's README shows an nginx snippet but it's specific to nginx ingress. we should add an AWS ALB note because samples will be used in workshops on AWS. ALB preserves headers by default, but if someone adds a lambda edge or API GW it might mutate them. short checklist in README would help.

tara: also hit a scary thing: debug logs in the sample printed a bearer token while reproducing locally. node logger strips secrets at info/warn but leaves debug untouched. we should flip the sample to `DEBUG_SAFE=true` so local dev doesn't leak tokens.

mike: sg. propose three deliverables: (A) small `sqsContextHelper` in sdk-js that injects/restores traceparent + x-request-id, (B) update sample README with ALB/API GW/ingress notes + troubleshooting, (C) enable DEBUG_SAFE in sample env and add a tiny scrubber in logger.

sophie: i'll draft the README bit and a tiny e2e script that: POST -> sends to SQS via sample -> worker consumes -> asserts same RequestId returned in payload. good regression guard.

leo: infra-bot: please remind: when deploying sample to staging, check that any proxy (ALB/nginx) is preserving `x-request-id` and `traceparent`. infra-bot: acknowledged.

mike: opened issue & PR plan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/512 (enqueue helpers + restoreContext) and PR branch sketch coming later today.

tara: thanks all. leaving WIP PR in sample-apps and CCing docs for the README changes. will post the small scrubber snippet in the PR for review. :+1:

infra-bot: CI | sample-apps PR 512  checks queued: lint, unit, telemetry-e2e.
